name: Clay Unified Semantic Persistence Fabric
source_concept: Persistent Clay organism-state whose associative memory can shape the next Assembly between LLM invocations.
core_rule: one semantic world != one physical store; one effect-critical operation gets one certified causal snapshot and authoritative commit domain
pipeline: external/internal event -> P0 AUTHORITATIVE_EVENT_STATE append candidate
typed Clay semantic identity + valid/transaction time + provenance -> P1
operation semantics -> MOSAIC/CertifiedBasis closure -> P2 CONSISTENCY_CAPSULE
assemble bounded current cognitive frontier -> Assembly/COVE
durable derivation/outbox events -> incremental graph/vector/FTS/activation maintenance
new activation frontier remains available between model calls -> next Assembly

planes.name: AUTHORITATIVE_EVENT_STATE_SPINE
planes.contract: append/replay exact events, state transitions, effect/outcome receipts; one commit identity per effect-critical operation

planes.name: SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_TEMPORAL_PROVENANCE
planes.contract: canonical Clay IDs, typed relation instances, valid/transaction time, provenance ancestry, conflict/revocation

planes.name: OPERATION_SPECIFIC_CAUSAL_CAPSULE
planes.contract: semantic hash, contract instance, required domains/epochs, negative predicates, selection requirement, capability dependencies; unrelated domain churn does not invalidate

planes.name: UNIFIED_CLAYCODE_QUERY_IR
planes.contract: exact address, relational, temporal, graph-role traversal, vector, FTS, latent-prior and authorized fallback operators share typed semantics

planes.name: PHYSICAL_PLANNER_ADAPTERS
planes.contract: route subplans to specialized engines using latency, serialization, contention, write amplification, recovery, energy and common-mode risk without changing semantic identity

planes.name: DERIVED_COGNITIVE_VIEWS
planes.contract: ClayGraph epochs, ANN, FTS, activation and Assembly caches consume canonical deltas, declare bounded lag, source epochs and rebuild recipes

planes.name: SELECTION_DERIVATION_RECEIPTS
planes.contract: bind query-plan identity, authorized search space, candidate set/ranking, selected anchors, source epochs, derivation version and exact view hash

planes.name: CAPABILITY_EFFECT_GATEWAY
planes.contract: model/database selection never grants authority; release requires operation closure, canonical resource identity, current capability and effect-relevant revalidation

planes.name: OUTCOME_REENTRY_CONTINUITY_LOOP
planes.contract: outcome appends canonical event, triggers incremental derived updates and can alter associative activation before the next model call

cognitive_state_continuity_loop.name: CSCL
cognitive_state_continuity_loop.purpose: Make persistent memory a continuously evolving substrate that can influence future cognition without forcing explicit memory-tool search as the sole retrieval path.
cognitive_state_continuity_loop.fallback: explicit exact/graph/vector/FTS memory query remains available and is required when automatic activation lacks coverage or confidence

consistency_classes.rule: single authoritative commit domain + operation-required snapshot witnesses + release-time revalidation
pin required canonical/graph/activation/frame/selection versions; exact-anchor validation for derived associations used as facts
bounded-stale derived views allowed when lag/provenance is explicit and no direct authority follows
eventual/replayable update via durable derivation log/outbox is acceptable

hard_invariants: canonical truth != activation != embedding similarity != retrieval rank != workspace ignition != model output != authority
semantic identity != provenance instance identity != basis identity != selection-plan identity != reader-view identity
derived view must expose source epoch/version, lag status and rebuild recipe
unknown scope/alias/consistency/selection integrity broadens or escalates
capability secrets remain isolated from non-authoritative cognition stores
physical placement cannot alter semantic identity or authority
effect-critical atomicity is defined over the required authoritative commit scope, not every derived engine
migration remains reversible until live target evidence clears correctness/recovery/common-mode gates
physical_default: HYBRID: canonical transactional event/state spine + specialized derived sidecars and transient cognitive fields
promotion_boundary: HOLD/OPEN until live FRANK traces, target persistence engines, crash/replay fault injection, Android/edge measurements and target-Qwen cognition tests validate the architecture.
